SELECT MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE) AS month, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(AMOUNT), 0), 0) AS actualExpense FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'EXPENSE'
AND TRANSACTION_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE) ORDER BY MONTH(TRANSACTION_DATE)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(AMOUNT), 0) FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'EXPENSE'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(PRE_TAX_INCOME), 0) FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} AND TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'INCOME'
